alt: Line graph. Horizontal axis time in hours, 0 to 10 in steps of 2. Vertical axis volume in liters, 0 to 180 in steps of 30. A straight segment connects (2, 90) and (6, 150). The horizontal and vertical tick intervals are equal lengths on paper.
caption: The coordinates come from the axis labels; one square has different units on each axis.

alt: Line graph. Horizontal axis time in minutes, 0 to 30 in steps of 5. Vertical axis distance in meters, 0 to 320 in steps of 40. A straight segment connects (10, 120) and (25, 300). Horizontal and vertical tick intervals are equal lengths on paper.
caption: Read two positions on the segment, including a value halfway between labeled ticks.

alt: Coordinate graph with axes x and y, both marked every 1. The entire graph is a straight segment from an open circle at (−2, 5) to a filled circle at (4, −1).
caption: An open circle removes that endpoint; a filled circle keeps it.

alt: Coordinate graph with axes x and y, both marked every 1. The entire graph is a straight segment from a filled circle at (−1, 4) to an open circle at (5, −2).
caption: Read the horizontal extent and the vertical extent separately.

alt: Scatterplot and dashed model line. Horizontal axis distance in kilometers, 0 to 10 in steps of 2. Vertical axis trip time in minutes, 0 to 60 in steps of 10. Observed points: (2, 20), (4, 25), (6, 50), (8, 45), (10, 60). The dashed line goes through (0, 10) and (10, 60).
caption: Filled dots are observations. The dashed line supplies predictions.

alt: Scatterplot and dashed model line. Horizontal axis hours a workshop operated, 0 to 10 in steps of 2. Vertical axis parts made, 0 to 100 in steps of 20. Observed points: (2, 30), (4, 40), (6, 80), (8, 70), (10, 90). The dashed line goes through (0, 20) and (10, 100).
caption: Use the line and the dot at the same input; each vertical tick interval represents 20 parts.

alt: Line graph of library visitors. Horizontal axis years 2018 through 2023, marked every year. Vertical axis visitors in thousands, 0 to 50 in steps of 10. The six plotted values in year order are 42, 45, 39, 30, 38, 47; successive points are joined. Each dot also has its exact value printed beside it.
caption: The vertical values are in thousands. Adjacent years are one year apart.

alt: Line graph of running-club members. Horizontal axis January through June at equal monthly intervals. Vertical axis members, 0 to 40 in steps of 10. The plotted values in month order are 24, 20, 28, 30, 22, 32; successive points are joined. Each dot has its exact value printed beside it.
caption: Compare successive changes and read the threshold exactly.

alt: Triangle ABC has horizontal base AB labeled b. C is above the base, with H between A and B. Dashed segment CH is labeled h and meets AB at a right angle, marked by a small square at H. Sloping side AC is labeled s. No lengths are given.
caption: For base AB, the height is the perpendicular distance CH, not the sloping side AC.
